task_instance: Translated a hand-written Mermaid sequenceDiagram (diagram.md) for a two-party authenticated key exchange (ephemeral X25519-style DH + Ed25519-style signatures + HKDF session-key derivation) into a complete ProVerif model (simple-handshake.pv), following every workflow step in SKILL.md: channel declaration, crypto-operation inventory, type/const/function/equation preamble, begin/end events, reachability + secrecy + injective-authentication + forward-secrecy queries, per-participant let-processes mirroring the diagram, a ForwardSecrecyTest process, and a main process with replicated roles.
blocker_detail: Not a blocker on the core deliverable, but noted for completeness: the skill's own declared toolset (Read, Write, Grep, Glob) does not include running the ProVerif binary itself, and this sandbox has no proverif package (apt-cache search found nothing) and no route to build it from source -- opam.ocaml.org and the ProVerif GitLab Pages download were both rejected by the outbound proxy (403), and a GitHub clone attempt failed for the same reason. So the .pv file's queries could not be executed through the actual verifier; verification was done manually via the skill's own Step 8 checklist plus a small consistency script instead.
tools_used: Bash (apt-get, opam, git, python3 for structural checks)
evidence: Files produced in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/trailofbits__skills__mermaid-to-proverif/: diagram.md (input Mermaid sequenceDiagram) and simple-handshake.pv (147-line ProVerif model). Verified by: (1) a Python script confirming all parentheses are balanced; (2) checking every declared type/const/fun/event is referenced elsewhere (no orphan declarations after removing an initially-unused aead_dec destructor); (3) confirming every out(c,...) has a matching in(c,...) with matching tuple shape/types (2 out/in message pairs for the two protocol messages, plus 2 public-key outputs and 3 forward-secrecy outputs = 9 outs vs 2 ins, matching the diagram's 2 network messages); (4) confirming both begin/end event pairs (beginI/endI, beginR/endR) are each triggered exactly once per process and referenced in the injective-authentication queries; (5) manually walking the Step 8 checklist from SKILL.md (participants -> processes, function declarations, destructor reduc usage, event/query pairing, long-term public keys published to the attacker channel, no unused declarations). Could not additionally execute `proverif simple-handshake.pv` to get a live query verdict: proverif is not packaged for apt/opam in this sandbox and the outbound proxy blocked opam.ocaml.org, the ProVerif GitLab Pages tarball, and a GitHub clone (all 403), so the toolchain to build/run the actual verifier was unavailable -- this is outside what the skill itself performs (its tool list is Read/Write/Grep/Glob only), so it did not block the core deliverable.
